review:
Praises: 
for a game from a triple A studio this game is filled with a dang good surplus of unique interactions, small details and Easter eggs to explore. 
The honor system allows different players to experience the game differently and gives good replay ability. 
Story is great with a good share of twists and good buildup, characters feel grounded and real. Lenny, Sally and Kieran are some of my personal favorite characters. and seeing the people slowly change over time as a response to the in game events is very fun. 
Also a good aspect of the game is that you can kill members of the KKK and the game rewards you with honor for doing that. 

Critiques:
I do think it struggles a bit from having to many mechanics that aren't fully utilized outside of one or two quests to introduce them. But those introduction quests are at the beginning and all placed really close to each other making the mechanics feel crowded and overbearing to the new player. Satchel upgrades give incentive to engage with hunting but it never really felt that needed, I beat the game without a single one. 
 Another critique is that like many other triple A games it suffers from a lot of character over crowding, Its another game where your character is already a member of a group and has been there for a long time, for that reason all of the individual members are thrown at you one after another and because your character is already canonically acquainted its hard to introduce the player to them in a natural way. Quests don't give time to expand on these characters individually instead having each mission play hot potato on who its focusing on and so most characters are hard to remember especially during the first half of the game. 
Also they killed online.

⭐ Not Recommended – One of the Most Overrated Games I've Ever Played

I genuinely refuse to believe people enjoy playing this game. At this point, I'm convinced the 10/10 reviews are part of some elaborate social experiment.

Let's start with the horse. Apparently, riding a horse requires a fucking PhD. Why does something as simple as travelling from A to B feel like I'm trying to land a Boeing 747? The horse has the intelligence of a potato and controls like it's actively working against me.

The controls are an absolute fucking joke. There are approximately 7,000 different keybinds, none of which seem to have been designed by someone who has actually used a keyboard before. Every five seconds I'm having to Google what button does what because apparently remembering 400 different inputs is now a core gameplay mechanic.

And the tutorial? What tutorial? Apparently Rockstar expects you to absorb the entire control scheme through psychic communication.

Controller aiming is somehow even worse. Trying to shoot something feels like attempting brain surgery while wearing boxing gloves. I want to aim at an enemy, not negotiate a peace treaty with the right analogue stick.

And the graphics? Don't get me wrong, they're decent, but holy shit, you'd think this game was rendering the actual universe with the amount of resources it consumes. My PC is working overtime to deliver an experience that looks nowhere near worth the performance hit.

I keep hearing about this incredible masterpiece, but so far I've experienced:

A horse with the handling characteristics of a shopping trolley.
Controls designed by someone who clearly hates human hands.
Aiming that makes me question whether my controller is broken.
An unnecessary amount of keybinds.
Performance demands that would make NASA reconsider its budget.

Apparently, the story is amazing. Fantastic. Unfortunately, I have to PLAY the game to experience it, and playing it feels like an unpaid administrative job.

I don't care how beautiful the sunsets are or how realistic the horse's testicles supposedly are. If I need a fucking instruction manual to get on a horse and shoot someone, something has gone horribly wrong.

Red Dead Redemption 2: 10/10 cinematic experience, 2/10 actual gameplay experience.

I wanted to play a cowboy game, not become a full-time horse technician with a minor in keyboard memorisation.

I genuinely don't understand the hype.

review:
Red Dead Redemption 2 isn't just a game to me. It's an experience I'll never forget.

Growing up in the countryside, the open fields, quiet mornings, mountains, and sounds of nature reminded me so much of home. There's something about this world that feels familiar in a way I can't quite explain.

I enjoyed every moment of this masterpiece. The storytelling, the characters, the atmosphere, and the incredible attention to detail make the world feel truly alive. Every character has something to offer, and even the smallest moments feel meaningful.

I've played many games, but very few have left an impression on me like this one. It's more than just a beautiful open world; it's an experience that stays with you long after it's over.

review: 真好玩吧。感觉自己真成为了西部牛仔
体验感极加，内容很不错
非常 好玩的游戏自由的很高，我可以骑着马去探索任何一个地方，真是一代神作，让我后悔的是为啥我现在才发现它，同时也希望如果未来有第三部作品的话不要太虐心了

它不是那种一路爽杀、节奏飞快的游戏，更像一台西部生活模拟器。
赶路要骑马，马会受惊、会累；下雨衣服会湿，踩泥身上会脏；打猎想拿完美皮毛，得小心翼翼，稍微搞砸皮毛就废了。细节细到有点“折磨人”，但也正是这些东西，让这个西部世界活起来了。
 
主线讲范德林德帮的末路，亚瑟这个人真的后劲很大。嘴上嘴硬爱吐槽兄弟，心里藏着善良，一边跟着帮派抢劫度日，一边又在慢慢寻找自己的救赎。打到结局的时候，心里堵得慌，不是打完BOSS的痛快，是看着一个时代、一群人慢慢走向落幕的怅然。
 
缺点也很实在：节奏偏慢，赶路花很多时间，操作动画多，急性子容易不耐烦；线上模式外挂多，只推荐专心玩单机剧情。
 
如果你愿意沉下心，不着急推任务，骑着马沿着河谷看日落、在湖边蹲鹿、在小镇酒馆坐一会，它会给你别的游戏很难给的氛围感。
属于挑人的神作，静下心来玩，才懂它好在哪。
玩之后感觉一直在被剧情强奸
